Pavan reported that in the presence of very light tasks (or cgroups)
the placement of migrated tasks can cause severe fairness issues.
The problem is that enqueue_entity() places the task before it updates

column2: thereby it can place the task far in the past (remember that

column1: light tasks will shoot virtual time forward at a high speed
relation to the pre-existing light task
column2: we can land far in the past).

column1: This is done because update_curr() needs the current task
might be placing the current task.
The obvious solution is to differentiate between the current and any
other task; placing the current before we update time

column2: such that !curr tasks end up at the current moment
